extracted.name: No Bake Fudge Cookies
extracted.description: Easy to make cookies with children. No baking is required.
instruction_lines: Combine white sugar, milk, and butter in a large saucepan; bring to boil for 1 minute.
Remove saucepan from heat and add peanut butter, oats, cocoa, vanilla, and raisins.
Stir well. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Let sit one hour.
